data.name: Sefton Asylum
data.detailed_description:
Become Sefton's new night nurse in a decrepit, secluded post-war asylum

When night falls, the day staff leave. You are alone with the patients.

But you did not come to Sefton just to work. You took the night shift to get inside. Your brother vanished there and every shift is a chance to look for him.

Yet every minute spent investigating is a minute stolen from your patients.

And at Sefton, patients you fail to save do not always stay dead. Every loss haunts the hospital and makes it even more dangerous.

You have the fate of many lives in your hands. The only question is: who will you save?!

Your patients? Your brother? Or shut the asylum down and put an end to its horrors?

Keep your patients alive

Every night brings a new wave of emergencies.

Examine your patients, assess their condition and choose the right treatment to stabilize them before they deteriorate.

Every treatment takes time. One mistake, One hesitation or the wrong treatment can make a crisis worse.

With time running out and supplies running low, you must decide who to treat. Keep in mind one thing:

You will not be able to save everyone.

Investigate in secret

Use your shifts to explore the forbidden west wing and uncover what happened to your brother.

Piece together the truth through the evidence you find. But the deeper you dig, the more dangerous Sefton becomes. You must choose what to carry out and what to leave behind.

Survive the night

All night long, presences stalk the forbidden corridors. They react to unusual sounds, spot careless movement and hunt anything they spot.

You have no weapon. Hide, keep out of sight or try to shake your pursuers.

But running makes noise, patients in crisis draw attention and every detour costs you precious time before dawn.

content_descriptors.notes:
Sefton Asylum is a first-person horror game set in a 1960s psychiatric hospital. Players should be aware of the following mature content:

Violence & Horror:
The game features psychological horror, implied medical violence, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter references to unethical medical experiments performed on patients, including reanimation of the dead. While the game favors dread and suggestion over explicit gore, some clinical documents describe procedures and their effects in detached, medical language. Creatures roam the hospital at night and can attack the player.

Sensitive Mental Health Themes:
The game depicts psychiatric patients suffering from various conditions in a 1960s institutional setting. Historical treatments portrayed include electroconvulsive therapy, heavy sedation, and lobotomy. Patients are portrayed as victims of an outdated and cruel system, not as threats. Some patients exhibit self-harm behaviors or express distress.

Other Sensitive Content:
The game explores themes of institutional abuse, medical malpractice, involuntary confinement, and the exploitation of vulnerable individuals by authority figures. A central storyline involves a family member being held captive and subjected to experimentation. The game contains no sexual content, no drug or alcohol abuse depictions, and no strong language.
